title: Repository map (repos.yaml)
description: Optional. Names the separate git repos a single project's pipeline spans (T42) — e.g. a frontend repo, a backend repo, an infra repo — and which pipeline stage writes into each. Absence is not an error: most projects keep everything in one repo, the same project root every stage already uses.

version.description: Schema generation of this file. Bumped only when a change would break an existing reader.

repos.description: Every repo this project's pipeline writes into.

name.description: Stable identifier for this repo within the map — lower-case, unpunctuated.

root.description: Path to this repo's own root, resolved relative to the directory holding this repos.yaml — so a relative path like '../frontend-repo' works regardless of where the orchestrator is invoked from.

stages.description: Which pipeline stage(s) write their code into this repo. A stage may be claimed by at most one repo in the whole map — a stage the map does not mention still writes into the main project root, where _docs/ and .claude/ live.
